map.将原始分数转换为标准 Z 分数，并给出百分位。: Converts a raw score into a standard z-score and reports the percentile.
map.Z = (x − μ) / σ；百分位 = Φ(Z) × 100%；距均值 =: Z = (x − μ) / σ; percentile = Φ(Z) × 100%; distance from the mean = |Z| standard deviations
map.Z 分数把原始分数 x 按其分布标准化：减去均值 μ 再除以标准差 σ，得到相对: The z-score standardizes a raw score x within its distribution by subtracting the mean μ and dividing by the standard deviation σ, giving the distance from the mean in standard deviations. The standard normal cumulative distribution Φ(Z) then converts it into a percentile rank, the share of data below that value. Z > 0 lies above the mean and Z < 0 below, so data from different distributions can be compared directly.
map.百分位 Φ(Z) 由正态分布累积函数近似: The percentile Φ(Z) is approximated with the normal cumulative distribution function
map.Z>0 表示高于均值，Z<0 表示低于均值。: Z>0 means above the mean and Z<0 below the mean.
map.标准正态下左尾面积。: the left-tail area under the standard normal.
map.Φ(1)≈0.8413，即约 84.13% 数据低于 z=1。: Φ(1)≈0.8413, i.e. about 84.13% of the data fall below z=1.
map.Φ(2.58)≈0.9951，约 99.5% 低于该值（右尾仅 0.49%）。: Φ(2.58)≈0.9951, so about 99.5% fall below this value (upper tail only 0.49%).
map.Φ(z) 与查表？: How does Φ(z) compare with table lookups?
map.Φ(z) 是标准正态 CDF，查表/工具均给出；本工具内置 erf 直接算。: Φ(z) is the standard normal CDF, available from tables and software alike; this tool computes it directly with a built-in erf.
map.右尾怎么求？: How is the right tail found?
map.Z 标准化（本页代码口径）：Z=(x−μ)÷σ（4 位）；百分位=Φ(Z)×10: Z standardization (as coded on this page): Z=(x−μ)÷σ (4 decimals); percentile=Φ(Z)×100%=0.5×(1+erf((x−μ)÷(σ√2)))×100 (2 decimals); distance from the mean=|Z| standard deviations. Validation: x, μ, σ are mandatory via input guards and must be valid numbers, otherwise a prompt is shown and the calculation stops; when σ≤0 only the chart and interpretation are skipped. Criteria: |Z|>3 is rated an extreme value (check for entry errors or a special subgroup), >2 a deviation (the outermost ~5% of the distribution), >1 slightly above/below the mean but still in the common range, otherwise a typical value.
map.判读口径（与上式互补）：另换算「每 10000 个中约 (1−Φ(Z))×100: Interpretation basis (complements the formula above): it also converts to "about (1−Φ(Z))×10000 out of every 10000 are above this value"; the reference table lists 12 levels of z from −3 to 3 (including the −1.645, 1.645, and 1.96 quantiles) with the percentile, the number above per 10,000, and the corresponding μ+zσ value; the shaded area in the bell curve is the cumulative share. Validation: same as above; rendered only when σ>0. Criteria: no fixed grading; Z maps one-to-one to the percentile, and Z=0 is the median position.
